$comment: Slice of the session section of AKConfig (ak-py agentkernel.core.config._SessionStoreConfig), from model_json_schema() with Pydantic 2.14.3; properties type, cache, dynamodb and connection_store kept, the rest dropped. Fixture for the P1b SchemaForm skeleton; regenerate the validator with pnpm compile-schemas.

table_name.description: DynamoDB table name for session storage. Table should have a partition key named 'session_id' and a sort key named 'key'
table_name.title: Table Name

ttl.description: DynamoDB item TTL in seconds (0 disables). Used to compute UNIX epoch 'expiry_time' attribute written per item.
ttl.title: Ttl

size.description: Maximum number of sessions to cache in memory
size.title: Size

table_name.description: DynamoDB only: name of the EXISTING WebSocket connections table (partition key 'user_id', sort key 'connection_id', GSI 'connection_id-index' on connection_id, TTL attribute 'expiry_time'); the store never creates it. Required for WebSocket modes on dynamodb sessions; unused by other backends.
table_name.title: Table Name

ttl.description: Seconds after which a connection mapping expires following its last write: the safety net for gateway pods that die without cleaning up (normal cleanup happens on disconnect and stale pushes).
ttl.title: Ttl

type.description: Session store backend: a built-in short name (in_memory, redis, valkey, dynamodb, cosmosdb, firestore) or a dotted path to a SessionStore subclass
type.title: Type

connection_store.description: The WebSocket gateway's connection store, provided on this session backend (spec #495 §9)

title: _SessionStoreConfig
